assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: OSM is included as a separately attributed provisional L2 trial layer under ODbL. Microsoft Global ML Building Footprints was checked against the published index, but no matching Beijing tile was found and no Microsoft geometry is included.
assumptions.impact: OSM improves visual context only; all L3 official controls and Microsoft coverage remain gaps.

assumptions.statement: Six facility records are method-calibration concepts. B0, S_min, RTO, CRV, ATS, R-Score, future-test results, and independent reviewer agreement remain unknown until field and operational evidence exists.
assumptions.impact: No facility is declared High-High, field verified, or implementation ready.

assumptions.statement: The published Microsoft Global ML Building Footprints index had no tile matching quadkey 132100103 for the provisional study bbox on 2026-08-28.
assumptions.impact: No Microsoft building geometry is used; the package does not substitute another region or infer missing buildings.
